_comment: Pre-existing color-budget violations. Routes listed here print a ⚠ warning in CI output but do NOT cause a non-zero exit — they are tracked, not silently ignored. Remove a route only once its violation is confirmed fixed. Each route must have a corresponding JBJ-### item in ROADMAP.md.
_provenance: Contents corrected in PR #48. The original list was drawn from a PR #43 CI log that reported 7 breaching routes, but that count was not reproducible: the audit skipped measuring any route whose shell lost a 6-second race and recorded it as a pass, so the same unchanged tree scored 3, 4 and 7 breaches on consecutive runs. After the race was fixed (JBJ-036), two back-to-back runs of identical code agree exactly, and the four routes below are the real, stable set. /mortgage-calculator was removed: it has no [data-tool-emerald] shell at all, so it cannot breach and was never being audited — it is one of the 26 routes the summary now reports as not audited.
